## Checklist
- [ ] Follows `TEMPLATE.md` and the naming convention
- [ ] Every resource has a tag: `[FREE]`, `[FREEMIUM]`, or `[PAID – OPTIONAL]`
- [ ] Links open, point to official sources, and have no affiliate or tracking parameters
- [ ] Prices came from the official page and include the month checked
- [ ] Anything I couldn't verify is marked "unverified, please check"
- [ ] `last_reviewed` is updated in the front matter and the visible status line
- [ ] New pages were added to `mkdocs.yml` nav and the README table of contents
- [ ] Nothing encourages unauthorized testing
